description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Alawala, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610036(1700-1)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land ownership records, including removal of co-ownership, insertion of new owners with their identification details, amendments to land extent measurements, and modifications to encumbrances and servitude rights. All content falls under land and property-related matters, specifically focusing on land title registration and cadastral record updates.
